text: Jen's knee op is 14 May at the Royal. She's dreading the anaesthetic more than the surgery. Remind me to text her the night before.
rachel's dog Biscuit had a lump removed tues, waiting on biopsy results. she's barely sleeping
Callum got made redundant on Friday. Eleven years there. He says he's fine but he really isn't. I should take him for a pint next week.

Just got off the phone with Shanice. Her nan passed away on Sunday morning, peacefully apparently. Funeral is provisionally 3rd of June in Leeds. Her mum is doing all the arrangements and Shanice is worried about her coping. Need to send flowers to her mum's house and ask Shanice if she wants me to drive her up.
Aarav and Laila are getting a puppy!! Cockapoo, collecting her June 3rd. Names shortlisted: Pickle or Mochi.
Hoang's cat Pho turned 15 today apparently. He made her a tuna cake lol
Note: Yusuf's dad's bypass went ahead 5/14, he's in ICU for a couple of days then on the ward. Yusuf flying back from Dubai on the 17th.
Ask Kalani how her MRI went. It was Thursday I think
Fiona and Rory split up. She moved out on the 2nd. Don't bring it up at Chloe's birthday drinks on Saturday
kaito vet tmrw 9am for the rabbit, Mochi's teeth again. he can't take time off so I'm dropping her in for him

Darius said his mother-in-law is coming out of hospital on 21/10 after the hip replacement and she's moving in with them for six weeks while she recovers. He sounded knackered, he's also covering for his boss who's off sick, so it's all landing on him at once. Their kids are giving up the spare room. Remind me to drop off a lasagne or something that week.
Duc - hates hospitals, faints at needles. Has his blood test on 9/12, said he'd rather not talk about it
Sean's wedding is off. Him and Ioana broke up last month, he only told people this week.
Pick up repeat prescription before Friday, pharmacy shuts at 6
Anya's cat Luna is really poorly, kidney stuff. Vet said they might have to make a decision by the weekend. Anya is in bits. Must call her Sunday evening.

Marcus starts chemo November 4th, every three weeks through to February if it goes to plan. He told me over coffee, very matter of fact about it. He wants people to treat him normally and not go quiet on him. Likes terrible puns and anything about Formula 1.

Dictated: so Alana rang about her brother Theo, he came off his motorbike on the A road Saturday night, broken collarbone and some ribs, he's in Southmead and they think he'll be out by Wednesday. Alana's going down every evening. I should send something to the ward, maybe the F1 magazine he likes.
Dmitri lost his job. Whole team let go on the 30th. Interview lined up for next Tuesday already though, with a fintech in Shoreditch
Vera - allergic to lilies (cats too). Keep in mind for her mum's funeral flowers.
Chen Gupta's colonoscopy is 26/11. His wife's taking him. Wish him luck the day before, he's dreading the prep

Ximena's parrot Coco is 30 next month! She's having a little party for it on Nov 8th, I'm invited. Coco likes sunflower seeds and swearing. Her partner Kaito built it a new perch for the occasion, apparently it took him three weekends and the bird ignores it completely.
kenji op went ok, home now. says the stitches itch like hell. physio starts 2nd of Nov
Sofia said her uncle died over the weekend - she's not close to him but her dad's taking it really hard. Funeral's in Porto on 12/11, they fly out the 10th.
Sara's new kitten is called Bean. Black with one white paw. Already destroyed her curtains
Remember to ask Adriana how the scan went on 19 October. She was nervous about it all week.
Dalia getting her gallbladder out 7th of December, keyhole. Off work for two weeks after. Her partner Rory's taking time off to look after her.
Jen texted, Callum's mum had a fall and is in hospital with a broken wrist. Not serious but she's 89. They're visiting Saturday.
Darius & Laila's dog Rocky got hit by a car last night. He's alive, vet kept him in, back leg pinned this morning. They're both shaken. Don't forget to message them tomorrow to see how he's doing.

Theo was let go from the agency, says it's a relief honestly. Wants to try freelance illustration, which he's been on about since uni. Has a portfolio review 3 Dec with a studio in Bristol and a meeting with an old client on the 10th. His girlfriend Chloe is a bit worried about money but backing him.
Yusuf - big Arsenal fan, does sourdough, has a staffy called Tank
Rachel Evans's mum's memorial is 22/11 at 2pm, the church on Mill Lane. I'm going with Fiona.
Need to book the dentist for myself, been putting it off since August
Shanice broke up with Marcus. Sounds like it'd been coming for a while. She's staying at her sister's for now. Text her this weekend, not before, she said she needs a few days
Ioana's grandad's 90th was meant to be December 3rd but they've called it off, he's back in hospital with pneumonia. Ioana's going over to Bucharest on the 1st to be with him.
Aarav said the puppy cried every night for the first week, they've got her crate in the bedroom now. Vaccinations done on 10/10, can go on walks from next week.
Kalani's results came back clear!!! Her oncologist appointment was this morning. Send her something to celebrate — she's been wanting that Le Creuset pan forever.
chloe's hamster died. she's 7 so it's a big deal. her mum Fiona is getting her a new one for her bday on 2/14
Sean's dad has his cataract op on the 3rd of next month. Sean's driving him, both eyes done a week apart.

Spoke to Anya after the vet. They had to put Luna to sleep Monday. She was 17. Anya's taking a couple of days off work. Ask her round for dinner next week, maybe Thursday, and get a card for her and her partner Kenji.
Hoang is on the waiting list for hip surgery, could be months. Says he's in pain most days now. Works from home Mondays and Fridays.
Dmitri's interview went really well, second round on Nov 6. He's nervous about the presentation part, has to present a case study to the whole board.
call the vet re: flea treatment, also ask about the cat's weight
Kaito Sato - neighbour at no. 14. Wife Alana, two boys. Retired surgeon. Loves bonsai.

Marcus says the chemo is knocking him flat, the third round got postponed to 25 November because his bloods were low. His sister Dalia is staying with him for now, she's taken unpaid leave and is sleeping on his sofa, which can't be great for her back. Remind me to ring him before the 25th, and maybe sort a food delivery.
Ximena got made redundant 31/10. Packing up her desk this week. Seems upbeat, already talking about going travelling in January.
Rory's labrador Bramble is due to have pups any day now. He's set up a whelping box in the kitchen lol

Dictation: Duc's grandma died Thursday, she was ninety four, he's flying to Hanoi for the funeral on the twentieth and won't be back until early December. His boss gave him compassionate leave. Remember to message him on the day of the funeral and ask if he needs anyone to water his plants while he's away.
Vera Mensah, met at Jen's. Vet nurse. Fosters greyhounds. Doesn't drink.

Had a long catch up with Adriana. Her ex, Callum, is getting married in March and she found out on Instagram. She's mostly fine but it stung. She's started pottery on Wednesdays and is thinking about getting a cat, probably a rescue from the place her friend Vera volunteers at. Her birthday's 2nd of February, a nice glaze set or pottery tools would go down well.
Chen's daughter had her tonsils out yesterday, recovering ok, living on ice lollies. Chen said she's back at school on Monday hopefully.
Sofia + Sara's anniversary 9/2, they got together the week after Sofia's dad's funeral so it's bittersweet for them
Laila's mum had her stroke 3 weeks ago, now in rehab. Laila's going part time to help. Check in with her, she's not coping but won't say it.
Kenji's dog Haru's first birthday is Oct 28th, he's doing a pup cup at the park on the Saturday after. Get Haru a squeaky toy.
Theo and Chloe have a gender scan on 5/11 - not telling anyone the result though
Dalia's ankle surgery was moved from 3rd Nov to 17th Nov, then cancelled entirely, they're doing physio first. She's gutted, had leave booked.
Book Rocky's booster jabs. Also order more of the kidney diet food. Car MOT due 30/11.
Jen's sister is in for her C-section on the 6th of November. Twins! Jen's going up on the 4th, back the 12th. I'm feeding her cat Mango while she's away. Ask her for the spare key before she goes.
Fiona said her boss is retiring end of December and she might go for his role, interviews mid Jan
yusuf: dad home from hospital now, on the mend. walking to the end of the road and back. he says thanks for the card
Aarav's grandad's funeral was last Thursday. Didn't get to go. Should give him a ring, see how he's holding up and whether his mum is ok.
